narrative.overview: A calm, clear pool of teal lit by a single warm coral. Deep teal-ink text and dark bands, a cool aqua-mist ground (not cream), brand teal for action, and exactly one warm accent. Bricolage Grotesque display over Source Serif 4 body, with a signature coral serif-italic phrase dropped inside grotesque headlines. Warmth comes from coral, the serif, and editorial photography behind soft arch shapes — never from pastels. The palette tilts cool-green where most parenting brands tilt nursery-pastel, which keeps it adult and trustworthy.
keyCharacteristics: Cool aqua-mist ground + deep teal-ink, with one coral accent — adult, not pastel.
Bricolage Grotesque display (tight, 600) over Source Serif 4 body (17px, 1.65).
Signature .hl: coral serif-italic phrase inside grotesque headlines.
Pill buttons (48px min), 14–20px card radii, an 'arch' doorway motif for hero imagery.
Diffuse low shadows; depth from tonal layering (mist → surface → pine bands).
Custom SVG decor and a bespoke interactive Growth Arc tablist.
Full light/dark theming via [data-theme]; reduced-motion honored; content visible by default.

rules.name: The One-Coral Rule
rules.body: Coral is the only warm color and appears sparingly — a mark, a highlighted phrase, a focus ring. If coral is doing more than punctuating, it's doing too much.

rules.name: The Coral-Size Rule
rules.body: Coral text must match its background: coral-deep on light grounds, coral-on-dark on pine. Plain --coral is for decor and large display text only — it fails AA as small text on both mist (2.85:1) and pine (3.98:1).

rules.name: The Cool-Ground Rule
rules.body: The body ground is cool aqua-mist, never cream/sand. Warmth comes from coral, the serif, and imagery — not a warm-tinted background.

rules.name: The Signature-Phrase Rule
rules.body: The coral serif-italic .hl is the brand's one typographic flourish. Use it on the headlines that most deserve emphasis — not on every section.

rules.name: The Eyebrow-Earns-It Rule
rules.body: An eyebrow appears only when it carries real information (age range, 'Free · sources shown', enrolling status) — not as automatic scaffolding above every section.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: Reach for a darker pine band before reaching for a heavier shadow. The page's depth is its bands, not its drop shadows.

dos: Do keep the cool aqua-mist (#F0F5F3) ground — warmth comes from coral, serif, and imagery.
Do size coral text to its background: coral-deep on light, coral-on-dark on pine, coral for decor/large only.
Do reserve the coral serif-italic .hl for headlines that earn emphasis.
Do use full 1px line borders on cards; let dark pine bands carry depth.
Do keep primary CTAs as teal pills (48px min) and 'Enroll' labels pointing only to checkout.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion, keep content visible by default (reveal is enhancement, never a gate), and keep the theme toggle working.
donts: Don't ship a generic SaaS/startup look: no gradient hero, no big-number hero-metric template, no identical icon-card grids, no purple-on-white.
Don't go clinical/medical: no sterile hospital-blue, no fear-based 'is your child behind?' messaging.
Don't revert to a cream/sand/warm-tinted body ground — Tidepool is cool by design.
Don't use a border-left/right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't animate layout properties (padding/width/height) — use transform/opacity.
Don't put an eyebrow above every section, and don't let the .hl highlight land on every heading.
